item.text: {"search_note":"I found no 2024 source showing Khamenei voluntarily accepted a meaningful transfer of power, loosened succession vetting, or honored coalition commitments that would constrain succession outcomes. The evidence is overwhelmingly about managed succession, not constitutional restraint. The only positive sign is that the formal institutions still existed and elections were held on schedule; that is not the same as respecting them.","evidence":[{"title":"Iranians expected to shun first election since death of Mahsa Amini","publisher":"The Guardian","date":"2024-03-01","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/01/iran-election-expected-turnout-mahsa-amini","summary":"The article notes that Iran still held elections for parliament and the 88-seat Assembly of Experts, the body that would choose Khamenei’s successor.
